title.zh: 卷96 志七十一 乐三 乐章一 郊庙群祀
title.en: Volume 96 Treatises 71: Music 3, Yue Zhangyi, Jiao Miao Qun Si
title.raw: 卷96 志七十一 乐三 乐章一 郊庙群祀

translations.literal: Treatise 71
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 71

translations.literal: Music 3
translations.idiomatic: Music 3

translations.literal: Hymns 1: Suburban Altars and Collective Sacrifices
translations.idiomatic: Hymns I: Music for the Suburban Altars and Collective Sacrifices

sentences.zh: 圜丘九章郊廟樂，順治元年定，乾隆十一年用舊辭重改。

translations.literal: The nine chapters of suburban-altar music for the suburban altars and temple sacrifices were established in the first year of Shunzhi; in the eleventh year of Qianlong the old wording was used to revise them again.
translations.idiomatic: The nine hymn-cycles of music for the Circular Mound and the suburban temples were fixed in Shunzhi 1 (1644); in Qianlong 11 (1746) they were reworked again from the earlier texts.

sentences.zh: 今以順治所制分載句中。

translations.literal: Now the compositions of Shunzhi are entered separately within the lines.
translations.idiomatic: The Shunzhi-era wording is now given separately within each line.

sentences.zh: 中和韶樂，黃鍾宮立宮，倍夷則下羽主調。

translations.literal: For the Zhonghe ceremonial music: the Huangzhong palace tone establishes the mode, with doubled Yize and lower Yu as the governing tonality.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhonghe ceremonial music uses the Huangzhong palace mode as the establishing key, with beiyize and the lower Yu pitch as the principal tonality.

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit · tune Shiping · Qin; [Shunzhi:] Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit (tune Shiping): “Qin” in the present text; [Shunzhi:] “Jing.”

translations.literal: Receiving pure blessing; [Shunzhi:] receiving blessing.
translations.idiomatic: We receive pure blessing—[Shunzhi:] we receive blessing.

translations.literal: Ah!—how manifest and all-pervading.
translations.idiomatic: How bright and all-embracing is Your grace!

translations.literal: The age is ever pure; within the four seas all is united.
translations.idiomatic: The times are ever serene; throughout the four seas all are as one.

translations.literal: We offer sincerity at the primal sacrifice; following the pitch-standards we attune the winds.
translations.idiomatic: With heartfelt devotion at this primal rite, we follow the pitch-laws and harmonize the winds.

translations.literal: Solemnly shall great blessing descend; thus You regard my slight person.
translations.idiomatic: In solemn awe great blessings shall come down, and You turn Your regard to my humble self.

translations.literal: Deeply I ponder Heaven’s height and Earth’s depth; I look to illuminate Heaven’s work.
translations.idiomatic: Deep in thought on Heaven’s loftiness and Earth’s depth, I hope to fulfill Heaven’s design.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] I fear to fall short of the great norm.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] I fear I may fail the great standard.

translations.literal: Thus the constant order is made manifest; morning and night it is proclaimed and carried through.
translations.idiomatic: So the eternal order is displayed; day and night it is proclaimed and brought to completion.

translations.literal: The cloud-chariot lingers in waiting; [Shunzhi:] the phoenix carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The cloud-chariot pauses in waiting—[Shunzhi:] the phoenix carriage.

translations.literal: Ah!—the phoenix carriage, empty and mist-veiled.
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix carriage hovers, veiled in mist.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Suddenly descending to the central altar.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] You suddenly descend to the central altar.

translations.literal: Green banners flutter and trail; Lieque and Fenglong [thunder and cloud spirits].
translations.idiomatic: Green banners flutter in profusion; lightning flashes and thunder rolls.

translations.literal: Solemnly at the beginning, harmony flows; reverently we look up to the azure vault.
translations.idiomatic: In solemn harmony at the outset, we reverently gaze up to the azure Heaven.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Blessing pervades the pottery and gourds.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Blessing suffuses the earthen vessels and gourds.

translations.literal: The hundred spirits reverently guard; all are pure as the sovereign lords.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred spirits reverently attend; all are pure as the assisting lords.

translations.literal: The spirit comes to feast and take its ease; only the Emperor is ever discerning.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit comes to feast in joy; only the Emperor is ever perceptive.

sentences.zh: 原恭仰顥穹兮，神來燕喜。

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Reverently looking up to the bright vault; the spirit comes to feast in delight.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Reverently we look up to the bright Heaven; the spirit comes to feast in gladness.

sentences.zh: 協昭慈惠兮，逖鑒臣原予。

translations.literal: Harmoniously manifesting kindness and grace; from afar discerning Your servant—[Shunzhi:] Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In harmony You show kindness and grace; from afar You discern Your servant—[Shunzhi:] Yu.

translations.literal: —the inner heart.
translations.idiomatic: —with all my heart.

sentences.zh: 奠玉帛景平靈旗爰止兮，樂在懸。

translations.literal: Offering jade and silk · tune Jingping · The spirit-banner now halts; music hangs suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Offering Jade and Silk (tune Jingping): The spirit-banner comes to rest; the music hangs from the stands.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Presenting the jade mat.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] We present the jade mat.

translations.literal: The attendants are reverent; they present the jade mat.
translations.idiomatic: The officiants are reverent as they present the jade mat.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Swiftly running forward.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] They hasten swiftly forward.

translations.literal: Thus sincerity and reverence are displayed; swiftly they run forward.
translations.idiomatic: So sincerity and reverence are made manifest as they hasten forward.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] There are fine gui and bi; white silk is offered.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Fine gui and bi jades are offered, with white silk presented.

translations.literal: Fine jade and measured silks; one after another in due order.
translations.idiomatic: Fine jade and measured silks are offered in proper sequence.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Warp and woof attain their pattern; hu and lian vessels gleam.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Warp and woof are rightly ordered; the hu and lian vessels shine.

translations.literal: You come in vast abundance; I think of You as if present in solemn dignity.
translations.idiomatic: You arrive in boundless presence; I imagine You standing in solemn dignity.

translations.literal: Your servant—[Shunzhi:] Kong.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant—[Shunzhi:] Kong.

translations.literal: With earnest care and cautious steps, I declare my central sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: With earnest devotion and cautious steps, I declare my heartfelt sincerity.

sentences.zh: 進俎咸平吉蠲為饎兮，肅豆籩。

translations.literal: Presenting the meat offering · tune Xianping · Auspiciously purified as food; solemn are the dou and bian vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the Sacrificial Meat (tune Xianping): Auspiciously purified as sacred food; the dou and bian trays are set in solemn order.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Raised delicacies and rare dishes are set out; the dou and bian are arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Delicacies and rare dishes are brought up; the dou and bian trays are arranged.

translations.literal: Delicacies are raised and set on the stands; how dare we not be reverent?
translations.idiomatic: Delicacies are raised and placed on the stands—how could we fail to be reverent?

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Auspiciously purified as food; reaching the round vault of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Auspiciously purified as sacred food, reaching the round Heaven above.

translations.literal: Roasted flesh and cocoon-like offerings; [Shunzhi:] the fine flavors of the Nine Provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Roasted meat and cocoon-like offerings—[Shunzhi:] the finest flavors of the Nine Provinces.

translations.literal: Ah!—fat and fresh offerings are presented.
translations.idiomatic: Rich fat and fresh offerings are presented.

translations.literal: Presenting purity in pottery and gourds; fragrant water from the spring.
translations.idiomatic: With pure pottery and gourds we offer; fragrant water from the spring.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] The special victim, pure and reverent; the feast is richly fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] The special sacrificial animal, pure and reverent; the banquet is richly fragrant.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Following; [Shunzhi:] descending.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Following; [Shunzhi:] descending.

translations.literal: Descend and regard us; the cloud-chariot halts.
translations.idiomatic: Descend and look upon us; the cloud-chariot comes to rest.

translations.literal: Bestow blessed fortune for myriads upon myriads of years.
translations.idiomatic: Grant blessed fortune for ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 初獻壽平玉斝肅陳兮，明光。

translations.literal: First offering · tune Shouping · The jade goblet is solemnly set forth; bright radiance.
translations.idiomatic: First Offering (tune Shouping): The jade goblet is solemnly presented; bright radiance shines.

translations.literal: Osmanthus liquor newly brewed; truly fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Osmanthus wine freshly brewed—how truly fragrant it is.

translations.literal: Your servant’s heart advances in grace; I raise the cup.
translations.idiomatic: With a heart advancing in grace, your servant raises the cup.

translations.literal: The clear liquor bears virtue; fragrant is its aroma.
translations.idiomatic: The clear sacrificial wine carries virtue; its fragrance rises.

translations.literal: The spirit’s kindness and gracious regard; splendid and august.
translations.idiomatic: With the spirit’s kindness and gracious regard, all is splendid and august.

translations.literal: Diligently I look up and halt; thus I wander in reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Diligently I gaze upward in awe; thus I move in reverent contemplation.

sentences.zh: 亞獻嘉平考鍾拂舞兮，再進瑤觴。

translations.literal: Second offering · tune Jiaping · The bells are struck and the dance swept; again the jade cup is advanced.
translations.idiomatic: Second Offering (tune Jiaping): The bells are sounded and the dance performed; once more the jade cup is presented.

translations.literal: Cautiously the bright rites are performed; in due order, solemnly conducted.
translations.idiomatic: With cautious care the bright rites are performed, each step solemnly carried out in order.

translations.literal: With serene countenance and easy bearing; the azure canopy is resplendent.
translations.idiomatic: With serene face and gentle bearing, the azure canopy shines in splendor.

translations.literal: Solemnly dwelling in acceptance; harmonious qi overflows.
translations.idiomatic: In solemn dignity the spirit dwells in joy; harmonious breath abounds.

translations.literal: The living people look to Your grace; gazing up at the jade chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The people look to Your blessing, gazing up toward the jade chamber.

translations.literal: Glorious spring and auspicious dew; celebration without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious springs and auspicious dew—blessings without end.

translations.literal: Final offering · tune Yongping; [Shunzhi:] Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: Final Offering (tune Yongping); [Shunzhi:] Yongping.

translations.literal: The final offering; the jade goblet is clear.
translations.idiomatic: At the final offering, the jade goblet stands pure.

translations.literal: Solemnly the black millet fragrant wine; harmonized broth is offered.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly the fragrant black-millet wine and harmonized broth are offered.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Slight sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] My slight sincerity.

translations.literal: Stone chimes and pipes ring clearly; the sacrifice is brilliantly manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Stone chimes and pipes ring clearly; the rite shines forth in splendor.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Harmonious qi ascends.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Harmonious breath rises upward.

translations.literal: Fine wine brims full; [Shunzhi:] brimming full, fine wine.
translations.idiomatic: Fine wine overflows the cup—[Shunzhi:] overflowing fine wine.

translations.literal: Ah!—may it never cease; think of its completion.
translations.idiomatic: May it never cease—hold fast to its fulfillment.

translations.literal: The bright mandate looks down in reverence; [Shunzhi:] may it still be drunk to the stop.
translations.idiomatic: The bright mandate gazes down in awe—[Shunzhi:] may the drinking reach its proper end.

translations.literal: Ah!—all blessings are born.
translations.idiomatic: All blessings are brought to birth.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Cherishing fine life.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Cherishing the good growth of life.

translations.literal: Eight dragons wind and coil; feathered pipes harmoniously sound.
translations.idiomatic: Eight dragons coil and wind; feathered pipes sound in harmony.

sentences.zh: 徹饌熙平一陽復兮，協氣升。

translations.literal: Removing the offerings · tune Xiping · The one yang returns; harmonious qi ascends.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the Offerings (tune Xiping): The single yang returns; harmonious breath rises.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Washing and offering complete; pure whiteness declared.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Washing and presentation complete; pure whiteness is declared.

translations.literal: Washing and offering complete; pure whiteness is set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Washing and presentation are complete; pure whiteness is displayed.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] In anticipation the spirit feasts in joy; we toil for the Emperor-spirit.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Awaiting the spirit’s joyful feast, we labor on behalf of the Imperial spirit.

translations.literal: Turning to withdraw the cleared offerings; how dare we hesitate?
translations.idiomatic: Turning to remove the cleared offerings—how dare we delay?

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] The hundred lords, solemn and harmonious; they tilt the jars and goblets.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] The hundred lords in solemn harmony pour out the jars and goblets.

translations.literal: The rite is about to be completed; music is joyful.
translations.idiomatic: As the rite nears completion, the music rings with joy.

translations.literal: Gazing at the nine gates; the great bell-frame turns.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze toward the nine gates as the great cosmic bell turns.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] No second line.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] (No corresponding line.)

sentences.zh: 福施下逮兮，佑此原宜佑。

translations.literal: Blessing extends downward to reach all; protect this—[Shunzhi:] fitting to protect.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing spreads downward to reach all; protect this people—[Shunzhi:] as is fitting to protect.

translations.literal: —the people.
translations.idiomatic: —the people.

translations.literal: Escorting the Spirit · tune Qingping; [Shunzhi:] Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the Spirit (tune Qingping); [Shunzhi:] Taiping.

translations.literal: Ascending the central peak to announce completion; [Shunzhi:] fine virtue long since accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the central peak to proclaim completion—[Shunzhi:] fine virtue accomplished long ago.

translations.literal: Ah!—dim mist over the altar ground.
translations.idiomatic: Dim mist veils the altar ground.

translations.literal: Solemnly thinking, turning to look back; the spirit carriage moves in vast ease.
translations.idiomatic: In solemn thought I turn to look back; the spirit carriage departs in stately ease.

sentences.zh: 原有山河日月兮，朗耀崇深。

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Mountains, rivers, sun and moon; bright radiance, lofty and deep.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Mountains, rivers, sun and moon shine bright, lofty and profound.

translations.literal: The Azure Dragon keeps the measure; the White Tiger rises and falls.
translations.idiomatic: The Azure Dragon keeps time; the White Tiger bows and lifts.

translations.literal: The great bell-frame is washed clean; evil portents quietly vanish.
translations.idiomatic: The great cosmic frame is purified; evil omens quietly fade away.

translations.literal: (Three lines.)
translations.idiomatic: (Three lines.)

translations.literal: Your servant—[Shunzhi:] I.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant—[Shunzhi:] I.

translations.literal: Seeking timely grace; moved in thought by fragrant offerings.
translations.idiomatic: We seek timely grace, moved by the fragrance of the offerings.

sentences.zh: 原有鳴玉鏘金兮，肅若有望。

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Jade sounds and ringing gold; solemn as if gazing in hope.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Jade chimes and ringing gold; solemn as if awaiting Your presence.

translations.literal: The purple altar, towering high; splendid and august.
translations.idiomatic: The purple altar rises steep and high, splendid and august.

translations.literal: Your servant rides the precious calendar; again I must assist.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant bears the precious calendar; once more I must lend support.

translations.literal: (Three lines.)
translations.idiomatic: (Three lines.)

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Receiving abundant produce; many scholars think of the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Receiving abundant yield; many scholars look to the sovereign.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi original:] Mountains and peaks gather the good.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi original:] Mountains and peaks bring forth the worthy.

translations.literal: Heaven bestows and Earth nurtures; the hundred grains flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven grants and Earth nurtures; the hundred grains flourish abundantly.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] cannot be fully exhausted and traced to the end.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] beyond all fullness to explore.

translations.literal: Multiply our fine host; upright, fair, and peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: May our good people flourish, upright, fair, and at peace.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] bathed in resting radiance.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] bathed in tranquil glory.

translations.literal: Burning Offerings at the Watch Fire · tune Taiping; [Shunzhi:] Anping.
translations.idiomatic: Burning Offerings at the Watch Fire (tune Taiping); [Shunzhi:] Anping.

translations.literal: Grand rites announce completion; sincerity is about to be offered.
translations.idiomatic: The solemn rites proclaim their completion; our sincerity is ready to be offered.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Thunder-chariot, lightning-speed; flying far and soaring.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Like thunder-chariots and lightning speed, soaring far on high.

translations.literal: Reverently holding fire; fragrant smoke ascends in offering.
translations.idiomatic: With reverent hands we bear the flame; fragrant smoke rises in the burning rite.

translations.literal: Thunder-chariot, lightning-speed; nine dragons prance.
translations.idiomatic: Like thunder-chariots racing with lightning; nine dragons rear and prance.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Rich assembly, brilliant bells; dragon banners are raised high.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] A grand assembly, bells resplendent; the dragon banners are raised aloft.

translations.literal: Purple vapors fill all four quarters; cloud-banners rise.
translations.idiomatic: Purple mists fill the four quarters; cloud-banners billow on high.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] May you flourish; descend, fragrant glow.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] May you prosper; descend with fragrant radiance.

translations.literal: The common people receive blessing; they follow the Five Constant virtues.
translations.idiomatic: The common people receive blessing and walk in accordance with the Five Constant virtues.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] wealth, long life, and health.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] wealth, longevity, and wellbeing.

translations.literal: Only I, the young one; reverent vigil, forever good.
translations.idiomatic: I, your young servant, shall keep reverent watch and ever hold to what is right.

sentences.zh: 原予獲疇祉兮，萬億斯皇。

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] may I receive such blessing; myriad myriads, thus august.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] may I receive such grace; myriad blessings, vast and august.

sentences.zh: 方澤八章中和韶樂，林鍾清變徵立宮，夾鍾清商主調。

translations.literal: The eight chapters of Square Mound music: Zhonghe ceremonial music; Linzhong qing with bianzhi establishes the mode, Jiazhong qing shang as governing tonality.
translations.idiomatic: The eight hymn-cycles for the Square Mound use Zhonghe ceremonial music, with the Linzhong qing bianzhi pitch establishing the mode and Jiazhong qing shang as the principal tonality.

sentences.zh: 迎神中平吉蠲兮，玉宇開。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit · tune Zhongping · Auspiciously pure; the jade firmament opens.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit (tune Zhongping): Pure and auspicious, the jade vault of Heaven opens.

translations.literal: Fragrant breeze; coming from the south.
translations.idiomatic: The fragrant breeze comes from the south.

translations.literal: Phoenix carriages in confusion; before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix carriages throng in succession, one after another.

translations.literal: Peaks and streams in mist; lingering and circling.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains and rivers veil in mist as spirits linger and circle about.

translations.literal: Solemnly performing the rites; reporting merit.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly we perform the rites to report Heaven's accomplishments.

translations.literal: Abundant spiritual blessing; the nine borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: Spiritual grace overflows to the nine reaches of the realm.

sentences.zh: 奠玉帛廣平式時原神州。

translations.literal: Offering Jade and Silk · tune Guangping · Shishi; [Shunzhi:] Divine Land.
translations.idiomatic: Offering Jade and Silk (tune Guangping): Shishi; [Shunzhi:] Divine Land.

translations.literal: Auspicious earth; the central altar.
translations.idiomatic: Upon auspicious earth stands the central altar.

translations.literal: Refined is our suburban precinct; [Shunzhi:] the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: Refined is our suburban precinct—[Shunzhi:] the sacred field.

translations.literal: Ah!—how utterly secure.
translations.idiomatic: How utterly secure.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] solemn.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] solemn and austere.

translations.literal: Feudal lords hasten with measured steps; taking their places.
translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords hurry forward with measured steps to take their places in the ranks.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] auspiciously pure.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] auspiciously purified.

translations.literal: Striking bells and beating drums; the Pan dance.
translations.idiomatic: Bells are sounded and drums beaten; the Pan dance is performed.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] spreading the banquet mats.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] the banquet mats are spread.

translations.literal: Yellow cong jade, fine-patterned; already set in offering.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow cong jade, finely patterned, is already offered in place.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] arrayed in order.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] arrayed in solemn order.

translations.literal: Spiritual radiance descends to illuminate; sincerity, cinnabar-red.
translations.idiomatic: Spiritual light descends to shine upon us; our sincerity is red as cinnabar.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] sincere devotion proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] our sincere devotion is fully declared.

translations.literal: Presenting the meat offering · tune Hanping; [Shunzhi:] Xianping.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the Sacrificial Meat (tune Hanping); [Shunzhi:] Xianping.

translations.literal: Rites proceed, music is played; [Shunzhi:] jade stands and golden music.
translations.idiomatic: As the rites proceed and music sounds—[Shunzhi:] jade offering-stands and golden instruments.

translations.literal: Ah!—not yet finished.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is not yet complete.

translations.literal: Fine dishes are presented; the great trays.
translations.idiomatic: Choice delicacies are brought forth on the great trays.

translations.literal: Sacrificial ox and sheep announce acceptance; only reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Ox and sheep announce that the offering is accepted; we offer only reverence.

translations.literal: The people's strength is everywhere preserved; solemnly we present.
translations.idiomatic: The people's strength is sustained throughout the land; solemnly we present the offerings.

translations.literal: Heavy Earth sustains life; nothing excluded.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy Earth nourishes all life, excluding none.

translations.literal: Tables and mats, the spirit comes; [Shunzhi:] look down and discern.
translations.idiomatic: Tables and mats are set—the spirit draws near; [Shunzhi:] look down and discern us.

translations.literal: Ah!—vast and ample.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and ample is Your presence.

translations.literal: First offering · tune Taiping; [Shunzhi:] Shouping.
translations.idiomatic: First Offering (tune Taiping); [Shunzhi:] Shouping.

translations.literal: Ceremonial wine, blended and refined; truly fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial wine, blended to perfection, is truly fragrant.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] Gourd vessels filled with clarified wine; at dawn we advance and raise.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] Gourd goblets brim with clarified wine; at dawn we advance and raise them high.

translations.literal: Broad and ample, raised to the kitchen; the cauldrons set square.
translations.idiomatic: Broad and ample offerings rise to the kitchen; the tripods stand ready.

translations.literal: Clear breeze, solemn and still; auspicious qi soars.
translations.idiomatic: The clear breeze blows solemn and still; auspicious breath soars on high.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] the spirit-banner is unfurled.
translations.idiomatic: [Shunzhi:] the spirit-banner is raised.

translations.literal: The spirits rejoice in harmony; the first cup is raised.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits harmonize in joy; we raise the first libation.

translations.literal: All hundred rites accord; the smoke-sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred rites are joined in harmony in the fragrant smoke-offering.

translations.literal: Exhausting the nine lands; abundant harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the nine provinces, harvests abound.

sentences.zh: 亞獻安平一茅三脊兮，縮漿。

translations.literal: Second offering · tune Anping · One bundle of river-reed with three ridges; filtering the libation.
translations.idiomatic: Second Offering (tune Anping): A single bundle of river-reed with three ridges; we filter the libation.

translations.literal: [Shunzhi:] River-reed; filtering the libation.
